svg.aria-label: Tom Bruno, Founder, Korext, AI code governance. AI writes code faster than people can review it. Proof has to keep pace. A map traces his path from Nairobi to Dublin to Paris to San Francisco, with TB at the center of developers, AI coding tools, policies, pull requests, proof bundles, open standards and compliance.
